newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-GM Q4 EPS estimates slashed.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-GM Q4 EPS estimates slashed.

text.p: -- Goldman Sachs and PaineWebber both sharply cut their estimates for General Motor's fourth quarter profits on Thursday, according to sources at the firms.
-- Goldman Sachs cut its estimates to $0.50 from $1.05, according to a source, citing incentive costs and SG&A (selling, general and administrative) expenses.
-- For 1996, Goldman estimates the automaker will earn $4.92 a share.
-- The stock remains on the recommended list at Goldman, the source said.
-- PaineWebber analyst Mike Ward cut his Q4 estimate for General Motors to $0.15 a share from $0.50 a share, according to a PaineWebber source.
-- 1997 earnings per share were maintained at $8 and the stocks's attractive rating remains in place, the source said.
-- General Motors shares opened off 7/8 to 53-5/8.
